title: Frequently Asked Questions | Keerthi Networks and Security Solution
description: Answers about CCTV installation, networking, biometric attendance, intercom systems, fire safety and site surveys by Keerthi Networks in Theni and Bodinayakanur.
lead: Quick answers to the questions customers ask us most. If your question is not answered here, message us on WhatsApp — we reply with straight, practical answers.

items.a: We are based in Bodinayakanur, Theni district, and serve customers across Tamil Nadu including Theni, Periyakulam, Cumbum, Andipatti, Dindigul, Madurai and Chennai. Contact us to confirm availability in your location.

items.q: Do you provide free site surveys?
items.a: We recommend a site assessment before quoting so the system is designed around your actual premises. Contact us by phone, WhatsApp or the site visit form to discuss and schedule a visit.

items.q: How do I get a quotation?
items.a: The fastest way is to message us on WhatsApp with your requirement — you can also use our Request a Quote form, which prepares a structured message for you. For accurate pricing we may suggest a quick site visit.

items.q: Do you work with businesses only, or homes too?
items.a: Both. We serve homes and individual customers as well as offices, shops, factories, warehouses, schools, hospitals, hotels, apartments and other organisations.

Yes. We design and install CCTV systems for homes, shops, offices, factories, warehouses and institutions — including camera supply, cabling, DVR/NVR setup, remote mobile viewing and after-sales support.

items.q: Can I watch my cameras from another city?
items.a: Yes. We configure secure remote viewing so you can see live and recorded footage on your smartphone from anywhere with internet access.

items.q: Do you service CCTV systems installed by others?
items.a: Yes, we take up maintenance and troubleshooting of existing systems — camera faults, DVR/NVR problems, cabling issues and upgrades.
Yes. We install audio intercoms, video door phones and multi-unit intercom systems for homes, apartments, offices, hotels and commercial buildings.

items.q: Can the intercom open my gate or door?
items.a: Many intercom systems support electric lock or gate release from the indoor station. We check compatibility with your door and gate hardware during the survey.

items.q: Do you provide networking for offices?
items.a: Yes. Office LAN setup, CAT6/CAT6A structured cabling, network racks, patch panels, switches, routers, Wi-Fi coverage and network troubleshooting are core services for us.

items.q: Can you improve slow or unreliable Wi-Fi?
items.a: Yes. We assess the building, plan access point positions and install a properly wired network so coverage is even and speeds are consistent across floors.

items.q: Do you provide biometric attendance systems?
items.a: Yes. We supply and install fingerprint and face-recognition attendance systems with reporting software for offices, factories, schools and other organisations.

items.q: Can attendance devices also control doors?
items.a: Yes. Access-control devices can drive electric locks, so the same fingerprint, face or card that marks attendance can also allow or deny entry through controlled doors.
Yes. We supply ABC dry chemical powder, CO2, foam and other extinguisher types, along with fire buckets and safety accessories, for businesses and institutions.

items.q: Do you refill and service fire extinguishers?
items.a: Yes, we support inspection, refilling and maintenance of extinguishers, with records maintained. Contact us with your extinguisher details and quantities.
